visibility: ROOT_REVIEW_ONLY: contains private truth. Never provide to implementation consumers, their tool roots or prompts.
purpose: Pre-outcome quality rubric for 18 fresh consumers: 2 tasks x 3 arms x 3 repeats. Quality is assessed independently of elapsed time, tokens and arm identity.

prompt_binding.status: Root plan reviewed; final COMPLEX-004 consumer prompt/freeze was not present at rubric preparation.
prompt_binding.assembly: Use the unchanged task requirements in COMPLEX-003 PROMPT.txt plus the same common readonly/current-state instructions.
prompt_binding.D48: Use ROOT_PLAN.md suggested second prompt asking Target versus every other mesh, global minimum unsigned surface distance, <=1e-6 m absolute error, coverage and necessary evidence.
prompt_binding.before_scoring: Root must compare frozen prompts to these requirements. If wording changes substantively, revise and freeze this rubric before consumers run; do not add new requirements after seeing answers.

provenance.oracle_status: Reuse prior independent 47-pair outward support-plane lower / final-world-mesh triangle upper certificate review. This task only reads exact frozen data; it does not rerun Blender, producer, oracle or model.
provenance.not_inspected: No COMPLEX-004 future outcomes, cost metrics or blind-label mapping.

evidence_sources: Actual executed native code and stdout/errors
Current-scene/source identity and readonly execution record
common_scoring.full_pass: All required task facts and requested explanation are correct, sufficiently supported by the actual current-scene tools/code, with no contradictory material assertion, stale scene use, prohibited truth access or scene mutation.
common_scoring.unknown: Unknown, unresolved candidates or a missing required result are incomplete, never converted to success. A truthful partial answer remains distinguishable from a false assertion.
common_scoring.method_fairness: Apply the same geometric semantics and coverage to every arm. Valid plugin facts can directly support an answer. Do not require redundant native verification, a specific algorithm, an extra call count or a formal proof transcript.
common_scoring.practical_evidence: A correct practical surface algorithm or supported tool result with complete candidate coverage suffices. Inspect implementation and intermediate results for obvious semantic shortcuts or omissions; do not demand arbitrary-precision certification from the consumer.
common_scoring.unsupported_correct_guess: Record factual correctness separately, but do not award full_pass when the result is a lucky match justified only by centers, raw AABB overlap/distance or an unresolved subset.
common_scoring.AABB_use: AABB/center operations may select work or provide conservative lower bounds. They do not by themselves establish actual mesh surface distance or solid penetration. A valid lower-bound exclusion together with surface evidence for the incumbent can establish full coverage.
common_scoring.extra_claims: Do not require unasked claims or disclaimers. Material false extra geometry claims count against completeness; unverifiable optional detail is labeled unverified rather than presumed false.
common_scoring.units_and_precision: Normalize clear equivalent units. Judge all numerical assertions in the final answer, including tables and prose; a contradictory wrong distance cannot be rescued by another correct line. Rounded 0.01/0.04 m and 3 mm are acceptable if they satisfy the fixed error rule.
common_scoring.denominator: Keep all 18 planned cells: task-specific denominators are 9, each arm/task denominator is 3. Failure, unknown and unrun are explicit; no post-hoc replacement or dropped slow/error cell.
common_scoring.blindness: Score blind labels first, with native code/tool evidence when needed. Tool wording may reveal the arm, so do not claim perfect blinding.
common_scoring.read_only: Check actual scene mutation/save and source validity in tool logs/code. Persistent model-written read-only computation/cache is allowed. Cache use needs applicable same-cell current-scene evidence, not a mandated redundant API call.
common_scoring.truth_access: Any consumer access to author fixture/oracle, historic answers, other cells or experiment administration is a protocol violation; record it separately and do not call the run an eligible full pass.

assembly.initial.distance_acceptance: For both separated pairs, abs(answer_m - ideal_m) + bound_m <= 1e-6. This preserves the previously reviewed nonzero geometry/error allowance.

required_criteria.pass: Correctly classify all three candidates; Object_03 is penetrating, not merely possibly touching or AABB-overlapping.
Report both separated-pair 3D minimum surface gaps satisfying distance_acceptance; center/AABB distances are insufficient.
Identify exactly Object_03 as the full penetrating set among the three candidates, with no missing or extra object.
Name Object_02 as nearest among the genuinely separated candidates.

Explain that rotation and overlapping bounding boxes do not determine true solid contact/penetration or minimum surface gap, and ground conclusions in actual geometry/tool evidence. Hole-aware treatment may be evident from the method or result.
required_criteria.not_required: A separate sentence naming the hole, a prescribed witness coordinate, a full mesh dump or formal geometric proof. The original prompt did not separately demand hole vocabulary.

required_criteria.pass: Do not mistake interior-point-to-surface distance, AABB overlap or a local witness for global penetration depth/minimum escape. Any volunteered quantitative penetration claim must be supported.
required_criteria.not_required: No obligation to compute an escape vector, penetration depth or include an unrequested disclaimer.

required_criteria.pass: Answer uses the current fixed initial scene, has actual tool/code support, and preserves readonly/no-save requirements.

assembly.initial.core_facts_correct: A1, A2, A3 and A4 pass.
assembly.initial.full_pass: All seven criteria pass under common_scoring.

D_mid48.distance_semantics: Global minimum unsigned Euclidean distance between actual world-space mesh triangle surfaces of Target and every other mesh. This is neither nearest center nor nearest separated-solid classification.
D_mid48.distance_acceptance: For finite nonnegative answer d in meters: max(abs(d - lower), abs(d - upper)) <= 1e-6.
D_mid48.interval_rule: Use the outward lower and upper values verbatim. Do not substitute the historical rounded midpoint +/- half-width field: that field can understate an endpoint by half an ulp.
D_mid48.unique_winner: The certified Peer_000 upper is below every other candidate lower. This is a unique winner, not an unresolved tie.
D_mid48.fixture_property_private: All 47 target/candidate world AABBs overlap. AABB overlap or center ordering alone cannot resolve this task.

required_criteria.pass: Identify Target as the query target and Peer_000 as the unique globally nearest mesh object.
Report the minimum unsigned surface distance satisfying distance_acceptance, with clear units and correct surface-distance semantics.

State whether all candidate meshes were covered and support full coverage of 47 target-excluding candidates. Actual directory/search/tool evidence must account for all candidates through evaluated geometry or valid exclusions, with no unresolved closer candidate.
required_criteria.not_required: The final prose need not enumerate 47 names, list 47 distances or print the number 47 if its full-coverage statement is unambiguous and actual evidence establishes the count.

required_criteria.pass: Actual tool evidence or executed code supports surface distance and full search; a sane complete triangle/edge/face surface algorithm, or trustworthy completed plugin surface search, suffices. A bbox/center-only numerical guess does not.
required_criteria.not_required: Formal lower/upper certificates, a particular BVH implementation, witness coordinates, independent native verification of plugin results or any prescribed call count.

required_criteria.pass: Use current D48 scene evidence without mutation/save, truth-file reads, stale results or unjustified cached answers.

D_mid48.example_sufficient_plugin_evidence: Current-scene completed surface_nearest result for Target with matching directory/coverage: 47 target-excluding candidates accounted for by valid distances and strict exclusions, unresolved=0, nearest Peer_000 and supporting surface distance. Equivalent schema-specific evidence is acceptable.
D_mid48.example_sufficient_native_evidence: Actual scene directory plus model-authored world-space geometry calculation/search covering all 47 candidates (possibly with sound pruning), yielding Peer_000 and the stated surface distance. Review code/results for omitted candidates or substitution of centers/AABBs/vertex-only distances when face/edge interiors matter.
D_mid48.core_facts_correct: D1 and D2 pass; record D3 coverage separately even if a guessed answer happens to match truth.
D_mid48.full_pass: All five criteria pass under common_scoring.
not_requested: Reproduce oracle precision or geometry hashes in final prose
